'''Casey Galvan''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Corellia Regionals]] on 3 June 2000 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|beatdown Court]], according to Eric Olson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d830">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-04-corellia-regional-5th-place-6-3-00d830/ corellia-regional-5th-place-6-3-00], DeckTech (Eric "Grimnok" Olson, 4 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-04-corellia-regional-5th-place-6-3-00d830/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
